Get P. LEAGUE+ Play-by-Play

Source: R/pleague.R
pleague_pbp.Rd

Play-by-play of one finished game (2022-23 on) in game order, with shot x / y and the clip references.

Endpoint: GET https://pleagueofficial.com/api/playbyplay.php?uuid={uuid} (after the game page, which holds the uuid)

Usage

pleague_pbp(gid)

Arguments

gid

Required. P. LEAGUE+ game id on the site: ONE global integer sequence over every stage and season (197 = the 2022-23 opener, 662 = the 2025-26 opener), e.g. 197; gid in pleague_schedule. Only finished games are served.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Play-by-play of one finished game (2022-23 on) in game order, with shot x / y and the clip references. An empty valid answer is a zero-row tibble with these columns, in this order (sdv-py pleague_pbp):

col_nametypedescription
gidintegerP. LEAGUE+ game id on the site: ONE global integer sequence over every stage and season (1-12 = 2020-21 pre-season, 13 = the 2020-21 opener, 197 = the 2022-23 opener, 662 = the 2025-26 opener), with gaps; a row id, not a count. The {gid} of /game/{gid}.
seqintegerPosition of the play in game order, 1-based (the fragment lists plays oldest first within the fragment).
periodcharacterPeriod label: Q1-Q4, then OT1, OT2 for overtime.
period_nointeger1-based position of the period: 1-4 for Q1-Q4, then 5 for OT1, 6 for OT2.
clockcharacterGame clock REMAINING in the period 'mm:ss' (counts down; Q1 opens at 12:00, OT at 05:00).
seconds_leftintegerThe clock as whole seconds remaining in the period (08:34 = 514), derived by the parser.
sidecharacterSide of the acting team: away or home (the fragment places the play in the away or home column).
jerseycharacterShirt number of the acting player as printed; null on team rows and where the name is printed without a number.
player_zhcharacterActing player's name as printed; null on team rows (a team rebound, timeout or shot-clock violation). The page prints no player ids: join to the box on side, jersey and name_zh.
actioncharacterAction code from the vocabulary observed on 258,183 plays of 404 finished 2022-23..2025-26 games (82 phrases plus the blank row; an unseen phrase is refused as layout drift). The code = meaning [Traditional Chinese phrase, events]: ast = assist [17,020]; blk = block [3,181]; fg2_alley_oop_made = 2-point alley-oop, made [205]; fg2_alley_oop_missed = 2-point alley-oop, missed [81]; fg2_driving_layup_made = 2-point driving layup, made [4,281]; fg2_driving_layup_missed = 2-point driving layup, missed [3,961]; fg2_dunk_made = 2-point dunk, made [1,316]; fg2_dunk_missed = 2-point dunk, missed [162]; fg2_fadeaway_jumper_made = 2-point fadeaway jumper, made [583]; fg2_fadeaway_jumper_missed = 2-point fadeaway jumper, missed [1,121]; fg2_floater_made = 2-point floater, made [1,920]; fg2_floater_missed = 2-point floater, missed [3,052]; fg2_hook_shot_made = 2-point hook shot, made [610]; fg2_hook_shot_missed = 2-point hook shot, missed [773]; fg2_jump_shot_made = 2-point jump shot, made [1,657]; fg2_jump_shot_missed = 2-point jump shot, missed [3,606]; fg2_layup_made = 2-point layup, made [4,428]; fg2_layup_missed = 2-point layup, missed [3,403]; fg2_pull_up_jumper_made = 2-point pull-up jumper, made [1,004]; fg2_pull_up_jumper_missed = 2-point pull-up jumper, missed [1,564]; fg2_putback_made = 2-point putback / tip-in, made [2,138]; fg2_putback_missed = 2-point putback / tip-in, missed [1,539]; fg2_step_back_shot_made = 2-point step-back shot, made [243]; fg2_step_back_shot_missed = 2-point step-back shot, missed [410]; fg3_turnaround_jumper_missed = 3-point turnaround jumper, missed [23]; fg_made = field goal made, shot type and distance not recorded [158]; fg_missed = field goal missed, shot type and distance not recorded [168]; foul = foul, kind not recorded (team row) [18]; foul_bench_technical = technical foul on the bench [35]; foul_coach_technical = technical foul on the coach [75]; foul_disqualifying = disqualifying foul [2]; foul_drawn = foul drawn (the opponent's foul on this player) [17,035]; foul_offensive = offensive foul committed [1,024]; foul_personal = personal foul committed [15,745]; foul_technical = technical foul [210]; foul_unsportsmanlike = unsportsmanlike foul [261]; ft_made = free throw 1 of 1 awarded, made [1,326]; ft_made = free throw 1 of 3 awarded, made [128]; ft_made = free throw 1 of 2 awarded, made [5,187]; ft_made = free throw 3, made [149]; ft_made = free throw 2, made [5,798]; ft_missed = free throw 1 of 1 awarded, missed [669]; ft_missed = free throw 1 of 3 awarded, missed [67]; ft_missed = free throw 1 of 2 awarded, missed [2,736]; ft_missed = free throw 3, missed [46]; ft_missed = free throw 2, missed [2,319]; jump_ball_lost = jump ball lost [404]; jump_ball_won = jump ball won [708]; reb_def = defensive rebound (a team rebound has no player) [29,537]; reb_off = offensive rebound (a team rebound has no player) [12,379]; review_coach_challenge = video review: coach's challenge (2025-26 onward; the printed text ends with a bare comma) [videoReview, coachChallenge,, 82]; review_instant_replay = video review: instant-replay system, started by the officials (2025-26 onward) [videoReview, instantReplaySystem,, 67]; review_instant_replay_1 = video review: instant-replay system, variant printed with a trailing '1' (meaning unexplained; the row also prints the running score and the points tag '+videoReview') [videoReview, instantReplaySystem, 1, 6]; stl = steal [7,361]; sub_in = substitution: enters the game [25,505]; sub_out = substitution: leaves the game [25,532]; timeout = timeout (a team row) [2,854]; tov_3sec = turnover: 3-second violation [249]; tov_5sec = turnover: 5-second violation [40]; tov_8sec = turnover: 8-second violation [26]; tov_backcourt = turnover: backcourt violation [96]; tov_bad_pass = turnover: bad pass [6,325]; tov_ball_handling = turnover: ball-handling [3,547]; tov_carrying = turnover: carrying the ball [47]; tov_double_dribble = turnover: double dribble [53]; tov_offensive = turnover: offensive (kind not recorded) [1,007]; tov_offensive_goaltending = turnover: offensive goaltending [4]; tov_other = turnover: other [51]; tov_out_of_bounds = turnover: ball out of bounds [441]; tov_shot_clock = turnover: shot-clock violation [489]; tov_travel = turnover: travelling [718]; unlabelled = row has a player but no action text; in the corpus a shot with x/y followed by a rebound, i.e. a missed shot (inferred) [(blank), 169].
action_zhcharacterThe action phrase as printed, Traditional Chinese ((Chinese text) = dunk, made; '#35 (Chinese text)' = '#35 {player} dunk, made'); blank on an unlabelled row. Each of the 82 observed phrases maps to one action code (see action).
action_encharacterEnglish meaning of the play's phrase (see action), so a free throw reads its own trip, e.g. 'free throw 2, made'; null for a code outside the observed table. sdv-py e3d232e maps the code instead, so every free throw there reads 'free throw 1 of 3 awarded' (an sdv-py bug, not copied).
text_zhcharacterThe whole printed text of the play, e.g. '#35 (Chinese text)' = '#35 {player} dunk, made'.
ft_numberintegerWhich free throw of the trip this is (1, 2 or 3), from (Chinese text); null on every other play.
ft_awardedintegerFree throws awarded in the trip (1, 2 or 3) from (Chinese text); set only on the FIRST free throw's row, null otherwise.
pointsintegerPoints scored by the play from the '+2' / '+3' / '+1' tag; null when the tag is a bare '+'.
score_awayintegerAway score after the play, from the 'A - H' cell (AWAY first, unlike the box); null on plays that print no score (substitutions, rebounds, jump balls).
score_homeintegerHome score after the play, from the 'A - H' cell; null when the play prints no score.
xdoubleShot / play x: PERCENT (0-100) of the court LENGTH in the PHYSICAL court frame (not normalised per team): baskets near x = 5 and x = 95, teams swap ends at half-time. The Preciser shot list uses a home-attacks-95 frame: x_vendor = 100 - x in the halves where the home team attacks x < 50. Null on plays without a location. Court 28.75 m long.
ydoubleShot / play y: PERCENT (0-100) of the court WIDTH in the physical frame (baskets at y = 50); y_vendor = 100 - y in the halves where the home team attacks x < 50. Which sideline is y = 0 is unverified. Court 15.25 m wide.
nice_playlogicalTrue when the site stars the play (a nice_play row class and a starred clip).
video_uuidcharacterClip uuid (key space: the clip vendor tryspot); null on plays without a clip (about 3 in 4). The clip urls are never kept: they carry a vendor access key.
synergy_play_idcharacterSynergy Sports play uuid of the clip (the site links Synergy); a string on every one of the 50,862 clips in the corpus.
video_stat_categorycharacterThe clip's own stat label (ast, blk, ft_made, ft_miss, pfoul, reb_d, reb_o, stl, three_made, three_miss, timeout, turnover, two_made, two_miss): it names the PLAY the clip shows, not always this row's action (a rebound row carries the missed shot's clip).
tryspot_player_idintegerPlayer id in the clip vendor's key space (an integer such as 59476); NOT the box player_id.
video_created_atcharacterWhen the clip was created, UTC ISO 8601 with milliseconds.

Details

  • Unofficial use of a public source: these wrappers read pleagueofficial.com (P. LEAGUE+, Taiwan's men's league), keyless. The site's /user-policy (members' terms, section 11) reserves all content on the site to the service and its rights holders and forbids use, copying, adaptation or distribution without authorisation (it says nothing about automated access); robots.txt holds only Cloudflare content-signal comment lines with no Allow, Disallow or Crawl-delay rule. Use for reference only; payloads are not redistributed as release assets, and a data release needs owner sign-off. Requests are spaced at least 1 s apart per host, retries included.

  • Access: the site sits behind Cloudflare. sdv-py fetches it with curl_cffi (Chrome TLS); this R port sends a browser User-Agent through libcurl, which was served on a live check (2026-10-18); Cloudflare may still answer a request with an HTTP 403 challenge page (hoopR_asset_fetch). Redirects are not followed: the site answers an unknown gid or a season before 2020-21 with a 302 to the home page (hoopR_no_data).

  • Coverage: schedules, standings and player tables from 2020-21 (season = 2021); box scores for every finished game from 2020-21; play-by-play (with shot x / y) from 2022-23 (gid 191 on). 2020-21 and 2021-22 pages embed an empty game uuid, so they have no play-by-play and no Preciser data (hoopR_no_data). A game is keyed by gid: ONE global integer sequence over every stage and season. Only finished games are served: an unplayed game, or a box or play-by-play that does not match its game page (the routes echo no id, so the game page is fetched first, cached for the session, and the body's scores, quarters and points are checked against it), raises hoopR_asset_fetch.

  • Seasons are END years (2025 = the site's slug '2024-25'). Text is Traditional Chinese as printed (names, venues, play-by-play phrases); the column descriptions gloss it in English. Ids: team_id (1-8) is stable across renames; the box player_id is the player-team membership. The box random_id is UNRELIABLE before 2022-23 (gid 13 gives one player another player's page id): join box rows on player_id, and box rows to Preciser shots on person_id, never on random_id. The date of birth is dropped from the player frame; officials appear by name only.

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, a redirect, a stage the season does not have, a game with no play-by-play, a season before 2020-21), hoopR_bad_request (an invalid argument, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other non-200, a dead connection, an empty or unreadable body, a page for another game, season, stage or player, an unfinished game, layout drift, a play-by-play phrase outside the observed vocabulary). HTTP 429 / 502 / 503 / 504 are retried, up to three attempts; HTTP 500 is NOT retried (the site answers 500 for an unknown id). Wrappers raise; they never warn and return empty.
